sentences.en: I love you, too. And I’m going to show you how much I love you.
sentences.zh: 我也爱你 我要告诉你我有多爱你

sentences.en: This speech, these pages have all of my breakfast items on it.
sentences.zh: 这篇演讲 这些页面上都有我的早餐

sentences.en: Avocado toast, jelly, everything. President Beilock, distinguished faculty, alumnae, family, friends, the 657 or so sisters
sentences.zh: 贝洛克总统 杰出的教师 校友 家人 朋友 大约657个姐妹

sentences.en: in the audience, graduating class. I’m going to make it plain: “History is not the past.
sentences.zh: 我要说清楚:“历史不是过去的事情。

sentences.en: It is the present. We carry history with us.
sentences.zh: 这是现在,我们带着历史

sentences.en: We are our history.” In other words: You’re a product of your environment.
sentences.zh: 换句话说,你是环境的产物。

sentences.en: Now that term is usually relegated to people from low-income, crime-infested areas…but why?
sentences.zh: 现在这个术语通常归结为低收入、犯罪猖獗地区的人,但为什么呢?

sentences.en: We all are a product of our environment.
sentences.zh: 我们都是我们环境的产物。

sentences.en: Your existence is an amalgamation of every triumph, every hard-won battle, every woman who had an idea and massaged it, and had the courage to use it to change the world.
sentences.zh: 你的存在是每一个胜利的结合 每一个来之不易的战斗 每个有想法和按摩的女人 都有勇气用它来改变世界

sentences.en: Every person who survived slavery, Jim Crow and the black codes, to the Trail of Tears, wars…and passed their dreams on to you—of love, of hate.
sentences.zh: 每一个幸存下来的人 吉姆・克劳和黑码, 到眼泪的轨迹,战争... 并把他们的梦想传给你...

sentences.en: Yup, you are also the product of the other: Of silence, of apathy, a school built on stolen ground.
sentences.zh: 是的,你也是另一个人的产物: 沉默,冷漠,学校建在被盗的土地上。

sentences.en: Of women, a parent, grandparent, ancestor who suppressed dreams and ideas, who died with lost potential and horrific memories of sexual assault, mental illness, who didn’t
sentences.zh: 女人,父母,祖父母,祖先 压制梦想和思想, 死于失去潜力 和可怕的记忆 性攻击,精神疾病,谁没有

sentences.en: feel good enough, or pretty enough or ENOUGH.
sentences.zh: 感觉足够好, 或足够漂亮或足够多。

sentences.en: Even your anxiety is part of your history…and yet here you are.
sentences.zh: 连你的焦虑也是你历史的一部分... 而你却在这里

sentences.en: Privileged, blessed…to do…what? There are two roads that I see that people usually take: The choice to think that your
sentences.zh: 我看见有两条路 人们通常走的

sentences.en: path is all about you and your success, how high you can climb in your career and your status.
sentences.zh: 道路是所有关于你和你的成功, 你能攀登你的事业和地位。

sentences.en: Or, the so-called “save the world” approach, where you have a vision for the world and, by God, you will change it because you’re different.
sentences.zh: 或所谓的“拯救世界”方法,在那里你对世界有远见,而且根据上帝,你将改变它,因为你与众不同。

sentences.en: The first road requires you to mistake your presence for the event, to be in complete denial; and, the second requires you only to deny the really bad stuff.
sentences.zh: 第一道路要求你错误地将你的存在 与事件, 完全否认; 第二道要求你只否认 真正坏的东西。

sentences.en: It requires you to forget racism, not see color, intersectionality, poverty… “but maybe I’ll take the sexism because it pertains to me.” Forget any evidence in my family of mental illness, of violence.
sentences.zh: 它要求你忘记种族主义,不要看到肤色、交叉性、贫困......“但也许我会接受性别歧视,因为它与我有关。 ”忘记我家里任何关于精神疾病和暴力的证据。

sentences.en: Forget anything in me that will get in the way.
sentences.zh: 忘记任何会妨碍我的事

sentences.en: Forget my fear, my pain. BOTH dead end. Both result in well-intentioned, very bright, enthusiastic people doing NOTHING.
sentences.zh: 忘了我的恐惧,我的痛苦,两条死胡同 都导致人们怀着善意,非常明亮,充满热情,无所作为

sentences.en: How about this as a novel idea: How about owning it?
sentences.zh: 如何作为一个新颖的想法: 如何拥有它?

sentences.en: Owning ALL of it—the good and the bad. Own the fact that the 39 delegates who wrote the greatest document, with the greatest mission statement, wrote it when slavery was an institution, Native Americans were being slaughtered and
sentences.zh: 拥有一切——好的和坏的。 拥有这样的事实,即写了最伟大的文件的39名代表, 写了最伟大的使命声明,当奴隶制是一个机构的时候, 美国原住民被屠杀,

sentences.en: women were fighting for their lives. Own the 100 years of Jim Crow that were implemented after the 13th Amendment, restricting the rights of people who were a quarter black, an eighth black, black-black, Native Americans,
sentences.zh: 女性为自己的生命而斗争。 吉姆·克劳的100年历史在《第十三修正案》之后得到实施, 限制了四分之一黑人、八分之一黑人、黑人、土著美国人的权利,

sentences.en: Malays, Hispanics, Jews. Own every gun-toting, violent, hate-filled shooter.
sentences.zh: 马来人,西班牙人,犹太人 拥有所有的枪手,暴力,充满仇恨的枪手

sentences.en: And own the fact that THAT is America. Own every heroic deed, great idea.
sentences.zh: 并拥有一个事实 那就是美国 拥有一切的英雄行为,伟大的想法

sentences.en: Own the mission statement of THIS school.
sentences.zh: 拥有这所学校的任务说明。

sentences.en: Own all of your memories and experiences, even if they were traumatic.
sentences.zh: 拥有你所有的记忆和经历, 即使他们是创伤性的。

sentences.en: Own it! Own IT! The world is broken because we’re broken.
sentences.zh: 拥有它,拥有它!世界被摧毁了,因为我们被摧毁了。

sentences.en: There are too many of us who want to forget.
sentences.zh: 我们中太多人想忘记

sentences.en: Who said that all of who you are has to be good?
sentences.zh: 谁说你要乖乖的?

sentences.en: All of who you are is who you are. It hurts, you rage, battle it out, ask, “Why?” Then you forgive, reconcile and use your heart, your courage and vision to fix, to heal and
sentences.zh: 你是谁,你是谁? 它伤害,你愤怒,你战斗,你问,“为什么?” 然后你原谅,和解,用你的心,你的勇气和远见去治愈,治愈,

sentences.en: then, ultimately, to connect, to empathize.
sentences.zh: 然后,最终,连接, 同情。

sentences.en: And that empathy creates a passion for people and it all is the fuel of the warrior- -a brave, experienced soldier or fighter.
sentences.zh: 这种同情感为人们创造了一种激情, 这一切都是勇士的燃料, 一个勇敢、经验丰富的士兵或战士。

sentences.en: It’s like Thomas Merton said, “If you want to study the social and political history of modern times, study hell.” Power concedes nothing without a demand.
sentences.zh: 就像托马斯·默顿所说 : “ 如果你想研究现代的社会和政治历史,就去研究地狱。 ”强权没有要求,就什么也不承认。

sentences.en: Know what that means? Women are under siege: suicide rates have skyrocketed, our reproductive rights are seriously in jeopardy, as is our pay, our healthcare, our safety, our worth.
sentences.zh: 妇女被围困了:自杀率飞涨,我们的生殖权利受到严重威胁,我们的工资、医疗、安全、价值也是如此。

sentences.en: Sex trafficking has risen by 846 percent in the last five years and three-quarters of the victims are women of color.
sentences.zh: 在过去五年中,性贩运增加了846%,四分之三的受害者是有色人种的妇女。

sentences.en: And in the greatest country in the world, we’ve seen a 26.6 percent increase in women dying during childbirth, and a 243 percent increase amongst black women.
sentences.zh: 在世界上最大的国家, 我们看到在分娩期间死亡的妇女增加了26.6%, 在黑人妇女中增加了243%。

sentences.en: You are graduating from a school whose mission it is to not just hand you a diploma, but a sword.
sentences.zh: 你从一个学校毕业, 学校的使命不仅仅是给你文凭, 而是一把剑。

sentences.en: You either start wielding it or you put it away as a conversation piece.
sentences.zh: 你要么开始挥舞它 要么把它当作谈话品收起来

sentences.en: Because there is a cap to success. Now everybody tells you that’s what you got to hit, that’s the best of the best that you can have in life.
sentences.zh: 因为成功是有上限的。 现在所有人都告诉你,这就是你所要打击的,这是你生活中最好的。

sentences.en: And then you hit it and then comes disillusionment, exhaustion, isolation, the imposter syndrome and a loss of passion.
sentences.zh: 然后,你打它,然后 破灭的幻想, 疲惫,孤立, 冒牌综合症 和失去激情。

sentences.en: Because no one talks about the real final cap, the real ceiling—and that’s significance.
sentences.zh: 因为没有人谈论真正的最后上限,

sentences.en: That living life for something bigger than yourself is a hero’s journey.
sentences.zh: 英雄之旅就是为比自己更重要的东西而生活。

sentences.en: That answer to your call, to adventure and journeying forth with mentors and allies, and facing your greatest fears, where you either die or your life as you know it will never be the same.
sentences.zh: 这回应了你的召唤 与导师和盟友一起探险和出征 面对你最大的恐惧

sentences.en: And then you seize the sword, the insight, the treasure.
sentences.zh: 然后你抓住剑 洞察力 宝藏

sentences.en: The hero at that stage must put all celebrations aside to prepare for the final battle.
sentences.zh: 那个阶段的英雄必须把所有的庆祝活动放在一边,为最后的战斗作准备。

sentences.en: The road back. The road back is the moment where the hero goes back to the ordinary world, where she must choose between her own personal objective and that of a higher cause.
sentences.zh: 回去的路。回路是英雄回到普通世界的时刻,她必须在自己的个人目标与更高的事业之间做出选择。

sentences.en: The reward? Your gift to the ordinary world? [sighs] That is the Holy Grail, the elixir.
sentences.zh: 赏金?

sentences.en: What’s your elixir? You know, my testimony is one of poverty.
sentences.zh: 你的灵丹妙药是什么?你知道,我的证词是贫穷。

sentences.en: You know, you heard I grew up in Central Falls, Rhode Island.
sentences.zh: 你知道,你听说我是在罗德岛的中瀑布长大的

sentences.en: And let me tell you something about poverty: You’re invisible.
sentences.zh: 让我来告诉你一些关于贫困的问题:你是隐形的。

sentences.en: Nobody sees the poor. You have access to nothing.
sentences.zh: 没人看到穷人,你什么也看不见

sentences.en: You’re no one’s demographic. You know what my “a-ha” moment was?
sentences.zh: 你并不是任何人。 你知道我的“a-ha”时刻是什么吗?

sentences.en: I had a memory when I was nine years old, and I remember my parents fighting in the middle of the night.
sentences.zh: 我九岁的时候就记忆犹新 我记得我父母半夜打架

sentences.en: It was so bad that I started screaming at the top of my lungs, and I couldn’t stop.
sentences.zh: 我开始在肺部顶部尖叫,

sentences.en: My older sister Dianne told me to go in the house or people would hear me.
sentences.zh: 我姐姐Dianne告诉我 进屋去 否则人们会听到我的

sentences.en: I ran in the house. I ran to the bathroom, screaming still, just couldn’t stop.
sentences.zh: 我跑进屋子里,跑到浴室里,不停地尖叫,不停地不停。

sentences.en: And got down on my knees, and closed my eyes, I put my hands together and said, “GOD!
sentences.zh: 跪在地上,闭上眼睛,我把手放在一起说,“GOD!

sentences.en: If you exist, if you love me, you’ll take me away from this life!
sentences.zh: 如果你真的存在, 如果你爱我, 你就会把我从这种生活中带走!

sentences.en: Now I’m going to count to 10 and when I open my eyes, I want to be gone!
sentences.zh: 现在我要数到10 当我睁开眼睛,我想离开!

sentences.en: You hear me?!” And I put my hands together and I was really believing it.
sentences.zh: “我把双手放在一起,我深信不疑。

sentences.en: “One!” And then I got to eight. “Nine! 10!” And I opened my eyes … and I was still there.
sentences.zh: “一!”然后,我到了八点。 “九! 10!” 我睁开眼睛.我仍然在那里。

sentences.en: But, He did take my life. He left me right there so when I gained vision, and strength, and forgiveness, I could remember what it means to be a child who was hungry.
sentences.zh: 但是,他确实夺走了我的生命。他把我留在了那里。 当我获得视觉,力量和宽恕的时候, 我还记得一个饥饿的孩子意味着什么。

sentences.en: I could remember what it means to be in trauma.
sentences.zh: 我还记得心理创伤意味着什么

sentences.en: I could remember poverty, alcoholism. I could remember what it means to be a child who dreams and sees no physical manifestation of it.
sentences.zh: 我还记得贫穷,酗酒,我记得 做一个梦想和看不到身体表现的孩子意味着什么。

sentences.en: I could remember because I lived it! I was there!
sentences.zh: 我还记得,因为我住在那里!

sentences.en: And that has been my biggest gift in serving.
sentences.zh: 这是我最大的天赋 服务。

sentences.en: “You can only understand people if you feel them in yourself.” And you know what?
sentences.zh: “只有你自己有感觉,你才能理解人们。” 你知道吗?

sentences.en: In the words of Joseph Campbell, you have not even to risk the adventure alone, because the heroes of all time have gone before you.
sentences.zh: 用约瑟夫·坎贝尔的话来说,你甚至不能单枪匹马冒险, 因为永远的英雄都比你先到。

sentences.en: The labyrinth is fully known; you have only to follow the thread of the hero-path.
sentences.zh: 迷宫是众所周知的,你只需要遵循英雄之路的线条。

sentences.en: And where you had thought to find an abomination, you shall find a god.
sentences.zh: 当你想到一个令人憎恶的地方 你就会发现一个神

sentences.en: And where you had thought to slay another, you shall slay yourself.
sentences.zh: 你想杀另一个人的地方 就要自杀

sentences.en: And where you had thought to journey outward, you shall come to the center of your own existence.
sentences.zh: 当你想到向外旅行时, 你会来到你存在的中心。

sentences.en: And where you had thought to be alone, you shall come to be with all the world.
sentences.zh: 在你以为孤单的地方, 你将会与全世界同在。

sentences.en: Now, you know, I jumped out of a plane recently—lost my mind for half an hour.
sentences.zh: 我最近从飞机上跳下来 失去理智了半小时

sentences.en: But, you know, when you’re flying up in the plane, you’re anticipating the jump, your heart is beating, you’re praying, you’re doing everything possible and then your instructor says, “It’s time.”
sentences.zh: 但是,你知道,当你在飞机上飞行时,你预见到跳跃,你的心跳在跳动,你在祈祷,你在尽一切可能,然后你的老师说,“时间到了。 ”

sentences.en: And this is usually my Wakanda salute to my sisters, okay?
sentences.zh: 这通常是我的Wakanda 向我的姐妹们致敬,好吗?

sentences.en: So, this is how I’m going to end it: when you put your legs outside of that plane, he tells you to “put your hands up, put your head back, and then you fall.”
sentences.zh: 所以,这就是我要结束它的方式:当你把你的腿放在飞机外面时,他告诉你“把手举起来,把头放回去,然后摔倒。 ”

sentences.en: So with my hands up, what I’m saying is that on this day of your genesis, your leap, your commencement, your mark in your history, perhaps your elixir is simply this:
sentences.zh: 因此,用我的双手,我的意思是, 在今天,你的起源, 你的飞跃,你的开始, 你的标志 在你的历史上,也许你的灵丹妙药是简单的:

sentences.en: that you can either leave something for people or you can leave something in people.
sentences.zh: 你要么把东西留给人 要么把东西留在人身上

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。
